historical_a9_manifest.role: immutable positive T5 package whose former open follow-up is falsified here

scope: Hash-pinned A1 production coefficients on L=16, the physical real first-component scalar ray, fixed rho_regularizer=1e-12, exact Fourier products, the sharp radial filtration P_prev=1_[abs(q)<K] and P_top=1_[abs(q)<2K], and finite-cutoff covariance-contracted Gaussian tilts N(h_K,K^-4 C_J). The result is an analytic no-go for one previously proposed sufficient estimate, not a negative result for the complete renormalised Class-II energy.
falsified_statement: For every eta>0, uniformly in cutoff J and every law nu absolutely continuous with respect to gamma_J, E_nu sum_j C_j >= -eta H(nu|gamma_J)-eta E_nu||phi_J||_6^6-C_eta.

counterexample.ray: Psi=f e_1, for which J_3=2 f grad f, K_3=[rho_floor/(f^2+rho_floor)]J_3, and the leading derivative coefficient is B_11=4 a f^2.
counterexample.triad: g_K=cos(Kx)+cos(Ky)-cos(K(x+y)); the three mode lengths K,K,sqrt(2)K lie in one dyadic annulus.
counterexample.field: phi_(j-1)=A e_1 and phi_j=A(1+epsilon g_K)e_1 with A=tK and 0<epsilon<1/3.
counterexample.law: nu_K=N(h_K,sigma_K^2 C_J), with h_K=tK(1+epsilon g_K)e_1 and sigma_K=K^-2. This is absolutely continuous at finite cutoff; its covariance entropy is O(K^3 log K)=o(K^6), its contracted value variance is O(K^-4), and its contracted derivative variance is O(K^-3).
counterexample.commutator_limit: K^-6 E_nu sum_j C_j -> -L^3 a t^4 epsilon^3(4-5epsilon).
counterexample.necessary_threshold: eta >= a epsilon^3(4-5epsilon)/(2 sqrt(((3/2)Y epsilon^2) M_6(epsilon))) > 0.
counterexample.lower_order_accounting: The covariance trace term is O(K^3), covariance-contraction entropy is O(K^3 log K), fixed quartic is O(K^4), fixed mass is O(K^2), and vacuum energy is O(1), so none cancels the K^6 defect. Fixed-floor polynomial-growth bounds plus the contracted Gaussian moments make all fluctuation and lower-shell corrections o(K^6).
